description: This Java source file contains abstract test cases for the Credentials API within the org.eclipse.hono.tests.registry package. It defines a set of unit tests and test utilities for credential retrieval, failure scenarios, and credential properties verification, intended to be extended for concrete implementations of the Credentials API client.

classes.name: CredentialsApiTests
classes.description: An abstract base class for credential API tests, providing common test methods and utility functions for subclasses implementing specific credential client interactions.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a CredentialsClient instance scoped to a specific tenant.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForNonExistingAuthId
methods.description: Test that retrieving credentials for a non-existing authentication ID results in a 404 error.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsByTypeAndAuthId
methods.description: Test that credentials can be fetched correctly for a given device and authentication ID.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForDisabledCredentials
methods.description: Test that disabled credentials are not retrievable (result in 404).

methods.name: testGetCredentialsByClientContext
methods.description: Test fetching credentials with a specific client context (disabled test).

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForNonMatchingClientContext
methods.description: Test that credential fetch fails if the client context does not match (disabled test).

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForNonExistingClientContext
methods.description: Test failure case when credentials are requested with a non-existing client context.

methods.name: getRandomHashedPasswordCredentials
methods.description: Utility to create a collection of sample hashed password credentials.

methods.name: getRandomHashedPasswordCredential
methods.description: Utility to generate a sample hashed password credential with secrets.

methods.name: assertStandardProperties
methods.description: Utility method to verify common properties of retrieved credentials match expectations.
